about: New NBA rule (from the 2027 draft): no team can pick first in two straight drafts or top five three years running. Orlando won the lottery in 1992 and 1993, Cleveland in 2013 and 2014. Ends on the Wizards consequence (our reading of the rule text).
name: Why can't teams win back-to-back lotteries
